title: sym101_cas13_collateral_activity_analysis: Cas13d collateral activity (SYM10X0)
description: Analysis of a Cas13d perturb-seq screen in A549 and NCI-H1299 testing for target-independent transcriptional effects: pseudobulk guide correlations, cell-cycle-stratified differential expression, GSEA and ribosomal-protein module controls. Sub-analysis of the manuscript "Uncovering RNA Dependencies in Lung Cancer through CRISPR-Cas13d Functional Genomics".
